title: Ukrainian rocket strike hits Russian temporary base in Makiivka on New Year
body:
Just after midnight on 1 January 2023, a Ukrainian strike hit a makeshift barracks, described as a provisional base, in Makiivka, a Russian-controlled city in Donetsk region. Footage showed a building reported to be a vocational college reduced to rubble. A Moscow-backed official, Bezsonov, said it was hit a minute after midnight.

On 2 January 2023 the Russian Ministry of Defence confirmed the strike and said 63 troops had been killed. Al Jazeera reported that Russia said six HIMARS rockets were fired, that air defences shot down two, and that four struck the building. The Strategic Communications Department of Ukraine's armed forces claimed that 400 Russian troops were killed and 300 wounded. Authorities of the Moscow-backed Donetsk administration acknowledged dead and wounded without giving a number.

Igor Girkin, a former Russian security officer, said the dead and wounded numbered in the hundreds and that ammunition had been stored in the same building. Al Jazeera said it could not independently verify either side's figures.
